chapters.screen: Gradient Boosting. Boosting builds a model as a team of small trees. Each new tree studies what the model still gets wrong and nudges the prediction to fix a little of it. Watch the curve sharpen one correction at a time.
chapters.spoken: Gradient Boosting. Boosting builds a model as a team of small trees. Each new tree studies what the model still gets wrong and nudges the prediction to fix a little of it. Watch the curve sharpen one correction at a time.

chapters.screen: Each dot is one California district: median income (x) and median house value (y). Showing 900 of the 12,384 districts the model trains on.
chapters.spoken: Each dot is one California district: median income and median house value. Showing 900 of the 12,384 districts the model trains on.

chapters.screen: Start: F₀ predicts the average price for everyone. The residuals (price − F₀) are what the first tree will try to explain.
chapters.spoken: Start: F zero predicts the average price for everyone. The residuals (price minus F zero) are what the first tree will try to explain.

chapters.screen: Each tree fits the residuals left so far and is added at 0.15 strength: F_m = F_m−1 + 0.15 × h_m. Later frames skip ahead several trees at once.
chapters.spoken: Each tree fits the residuals left so far and is added at 0.15 strength: F m equals F m minus 1 plus 0.15 times h m. Later frames skip ahead several trees at once.

chapters.screen: 80 trees: train RMSE $82k, validation $83k. Small, shrunken steps keep any single tree from over-reacting.
chapters.spoken: 80 trees: train root mean squared error 82 thousand dollars, validation 83 thousand dollars. Small, shrunken steps keep any single tree from over-reacting.

chapters.screen: For an unseen district boosting starts at the average price, then every tree adds its small correction; the running total is the prediction.
chapters.spoken: For an unseen district boosting starts at the average price, then every tree adds its small correction; the running total is the prediction.

chapters.screen: Final exam: the trained model prices all 4,128 test districts it has never seen, a batch at a time. The map shows where it misses: blue = worth more than predicted.
chapters.spoken: Final exam: the trained model prices all 4,128 test districts it has never seen, a batch at a time. The map shows where it misses: blue means worth more than predicted.

chapters.screen: Boosting adds up many small trees' corrections, so the sheet is built from small steps. Same algorithm, now given house age as well as income; height is its predicted price.
chapters.spoken: Boosting adds up many small trees' corrections, so the sheet is built from small steps. Same algorithm, now given house age as well as income; height is its predicted price.

chapters.screen: Seven more inputs cut the typical error from $83k to $57k.
chapters.spoken: Seven more inputs cut the typical error from 83 thousand dollars to 57 thousand dollars.

chapters.screen: Boosting turns many weak trees into a strong model by fitting each new tree to the errors that remain. Limitation: trees are added in sequence, so training cannot be parallelised across trees, and too many trees or a high learning rate will fit noise.
chapters.spoken: Boosting turns many weak trees into a strong model by fitting each new tree to the errors that remain. Limitation: trees are added in sequence, so training cannot be parallelised across trees, and too many trees or a high learning rate will fit noise.
